title: SSAS Fleet Overview
description: Fleet triage for SSAS using windows_exporter textfile collectors and host metrics. Dashboard refresh 1m; actual scrape cadence is managed in Prometheus. Collector freshness defaults to 300 seconds. Inventory is discovered over 24h from SSAS metrics/services; it is not an authoritative CMDB. Unknown is never healthy.

targets.expr: count(group by (job,instance) (max_over_time(ssas_up{job=~"${job:regex}",owner=~"${owner:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[24h]) or max_over_time(windows_service_state{job=~"${job:regex}",owner=~"${owner:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",name=~"(?i)MSSQLServerOLAPService|MSOLAP.+"}[24h]) or max_over_time(up{job=~"${job:regex}",owner=~"${owner:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",instance=~"${extra_hosts:raw}"}[24h])))

panels.title: SSAS Memory / High Limit

options.content:
**Start with Fleet Triage:** Probe State is connectivity only. Check collector errors, CPU/RAM, disk, memory limits, queues, locks and stale databases separately. Click a Server for drill-down.

**Inventory:** last 24h of SSAS metrics or Windows SSAS service inventory. Hosts never observed are not automatically discoverable. Use **Additional SSAS hosts (regex)** to include known Windows scrape targets (for example `SSAS01|SSAS02`). Hosts absent from Prometheus still require an external inventory comparison. This dashboard does not claim full fleet coverage.

**Freshness:** data older than the selected threshold (default 300 seconds), from future collector timestamps, or from a failed scrape is excluded from SSAS workload panels. Missing is **Unknown**, never zero. Collector errors can indicate partial data even when the probe succeeds.

**Triage hints:** host CPU/RAM 80/90%; disk free 20/10%; SSAS high-memory-limit ratio 85/100%. Tune to workload. No alert rules are created. Processing stale flags use collector configuration. Backups and recovery readiness are not assessed here.

**Fleet charts:** horizontal Top 10 rankings show current values, not historical trends. Select fewer servers to compare that subset. All discovered servers remain in Fleet Triage. Job is retained internally for query identity but is hidden from tables.
